name: Santoor Women's Scholarship Program 2026-27
provider: Wipro Consumer Care and Wipro Cares

rules.quote: The program intends to financially support girls from disadvantaged backgrounds, who wish to pursue higher education after grade 12.
This year, the Santoor Scholarship will extend financial support to 1000 eligible girl students, across the states of Andhra Pradesh and Maharashtra.

rules.value: class 10 from local government school; class 12 from government school/junior college in 2025-26
rules.quote: Passed class 12 from a government school/junior college in the academic year 2025-26.
Enrolled in an undergraduate program beginning 2026-27.

rules.value: preference to backward districts; humanities/arts/sciences encouraged
rules.quote: Preference is given to students from backward districts.

amount.text: Rs 30,000 per annum till completion of the course
amount.quote: The students would be given Rs. 30,000 per annum till they complete their course of study.

deadline.quote: The last date for applying is 15th October, 2026.
